items.exampleEn: This drawer is full of old letters.
items.exampleZh: 這個抽屜裝滿了舊信件。

items.exampleEn: Don't forget to buy soap at the supermarket.
My dad used a drill to make a hole in the wall.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸用電鑽在牆上鑽了一個洞。

items.exampleEn: We need a new bulb for the kitchen lamp.
items.exampleZh: 廚房的燈需要換一顆新燈泡。

items.exampleEn: The garage is full of junk.
items.exampleZh: 車庫裡堆滿了破爛東西。

items.exampleEn: We grow flowers on our balcony.
My grandmother taught me how to sew.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶教我怎麼縫東西。

items.sentenceEn: Can you change the bulb in the kitchen?
items.sentenceZh: 你可以換一下廚房的燈泡嗎？

items.audioEn: Your keys are in the drawer next to the door downstairs.
items.audioZh: 你的鑰匙在樓下門旁邊的抽屜裡。

items.sentenceEn: She sewed a button on my shirt.
items.sentenceZh: 她幫我在襯衫上縫了一顆釦子。

items.sentenceEn: Let's throw out all this junk.
items.sentenceZh: 我們把這些沒用的東西全丟掉吧。

items.stemEn: There is no ____ in the bathroom, so I can't wash my hands.
items.stemZh: 浴室裡沒有肥皂，所以我沒辦法洗手。

items.stemEn: My room is ____, on the second floor.
items.stemZh: 我的房間在樓上，在二樓。

items.passageEn: Every spring, Tina cleans her whole house. Upstairs, she empties every drawer and throws away old junk. Downstairs, she cleans the floor with soap and water. She also changes all the old light bulbs. When everything is done, she sits on her balcony and sews buttons on old shirts.
items.passageZh: 每年春天，Tina 都會把整間房子打掃一遍。在樓上，她清空每個抽屜，把舊的沒用東西丟掉。在樓下，她用肥皂和水清洗地板。她也會把舊燈泡全部換掉。全部做完後，她就坐在陽台上，替舊襯衫縫釦子。

options: 清空抽屜、丟掉沒用的東西

referenceEn: Could I borrow your drill, please?
rubricZh: 「跟你借」用 borrow（例如 borrow your drill）
問句可用例如 Can I…?、Could I…?、May I…?

items.instructionZh: 用 balcony 造一個句子，說說你家的陽台，或你想要的陽台。
referenceEn: We have a small balcony with many plants.
I like to drink coffee on the balcony.
rubricZh: balcony 是可數名詞（例如 a small balcony、our balcony）
「在陽台上」用 on（例如 on the balcony）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：時態邏輯不連貫：全文以 Every spring 寫習慣（現在式），中間插入 Last weekend she also changed…（單次過去事件），接著又回到 When everything is done, she sits…；讀者無法判斷換燈泡是否每年春天的一部分。建議統一為「今年春天」的過去式敘事，或刪掉 Last weekend
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Every spring, Tina cleans her whole house. Upstairs, she empties every drawer and throws away old junk. Downstairs, she cleans the floor with soap and water. She also changes all the old light bulbs. When everything is done, she sits on her balcony and sews buttons on old shirts."（原 "Every spring, Tina cleans her whole house. Upstairs, she empties every drawer and throws away old junk. Downstairs, she cleans the floor with soap and water. Last weekend, she also changed all the old light bulbs. When everything is done, she sits on her balcony and sews buttons on old shirts."）；統一為每年春天的習慣（現在式）
